_comment: Documents the execution order of backend pipeline stages. Each HTTP request flows through these stages in the listed order (top to bottom). The pipeline wraps from last to first: the first stage is the outermost wrapper (executed first on request, last on response).

pipeline_stages.name: rate_limiting
pipeline_stages.description: Rejects requests exceeding per-function rate limits

pipeline_stages.name: logging
pipeline_stages.description: Logs basic HTTP request info when debug mode is enabled

pipeline_stages.name: error_handling
pipeline_stages.description: Recovers from panics, logs stack traces, returns 500

pipeline_stages.name: auth
pipeline_stages.description: Validates user session — rejects unauthenticated requests

pipeline_stages.name: device_id
pipeline_stages.description: Validates device ID header matches session

non_stage_pipeline_folders.name: router
non_stage_pipeline_folders.description: Route definitions — maps URL patterns to handlers with pipeline profiles

non_stage_pipeline_folders.name: shared
non_stage_pipeline_folders.description: Cross-cutting middleware not in the main pipeline (CSP, CSRF, security headers, maintenance mode, panic recovery, transaction wrapper, firewall, app-specific chains)

engine_files: pipeline/pipeline.go — Stage type definition and BuildPipeline function
pipeline/pipeline_order.go — PipelineOrder array (single source of truth for stage sequence)
pipeline/build_pipeline.go — Pipeline construction from route profiles
pipeline/introspection_handler.go — Debug endpoint listing active stages
